description_en: Queries the throttling rules that are being executed or have been triggered
description_zh: 调用GetSqlConcurrencyControlRulesHistory接口，获取正在执行或被触发过的限流规则
name: GetSqlConcurrencyControlRulesHistory

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

Only ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL instances and PolarDB for MySQL clusters are supported
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。
仅支持RDS MySQL和 PolarDB MySQL版实例
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The page number. The value must be an integer that is greater than 0. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 页码，取值大于0且不超过Integer数据类型的最大值，默认值为1
parameters.name: page_no

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. The value must be an integer that is greater than 0. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 每页最大记录数，取值大于0且不超过Integer数据类型的最大值，默认值为10
parameters.name: page_size

Data.description_en: The detailed information, including the error codes and the number of entries that are returned
Data.description_zh: 详细信息列表，包括信息总数、错误码等

rules.description_en: The list of the queried throttling rules

ConcurrencyControlTime.description_en:
The duration within which the SQL throttling rule takes effect. Unit: seconds.

The throttling rule takes effect only within this duration
ConcurrencyControlTime.description_zh:
SQL限流的生效时长，单位为秒。
限流规则仅在生效时间内开启

ItemId.description_en: The ID of the throttling rule that is applied to the instance

KeywordsHash.description_en: The hash value of the SQL keywords. The SQL keywords are contained in the SQL statements to which the throttling rule is applied
KeywordsHash.description_zh: 哈希值，根据输入的限流关键词计算出来的值

MaxConcurrency.description_en:
The maximum number of concurrent SQL statements. Set this parameter to a positive integer.

When the number of concurrent SQL statements that contain the specified keywords reaches this upper limit, the throttling rule is triggered
MaxConcurrency.description_zh:
SQL最大并发数，取值为大于或等于1的整数。
当包含关键词的SQL达到最大并发数时会触发限流策略

SqlKeywords.description_en:
The keywords that are used to identify the SQL statements that need to be throttled.

SQL keywords are separated with tildes (\~). When the number of concurrent SQL statements that contain all the specified SQL keywords reaches the specified upper limit, the throttling rule is triggered
SqlKeywords.description_zh:
需要限流的SQL关键词。
多个关键词间以波浪线（~）分隔，SQL语句中需要同时包含这些关键词才会触发限流规则

SqlType.description_en:
The type of the SQL statements. Valid values:

SELECT

UPDATE

DELETE
SqlType.description_zh:
选择SQL的类型。取值：
SELECT
UPDATE
DELETE

StartTime.description_en: The beginning of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC
StartTime.description_zh: 获取限流规则历史的开始时间，格式为Unix时间戳，单位为毫秒

Status.description_en:
The state of the throttling rule. Valid values:

Open: The throttling rule is in effect.

Closed: The throttling rule was in effect
Status.description_zh:
限流规则的生效状态，取值：

Open：限流规则正在生效中。
Closed：限流规则已执行结束

Total.description_en: The total number of entries returned

Message.description_en:
The returned message.

If the request was successful, Successful is returned. If the request failed, an error message such as an error code is returned
Message.description_zh:
请求返回消息。
请求成功时该参数返回Successful，请求失败时会返回请求异常信息（如错误码等）

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true: The request was successful.

false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
请求是否执行成功：

true：执行成功
false：执行失败
